finnhub-140845460.headline: Apple to spend $30 billion on US-made chips from Broadcom
finnhub-140845460.summary: STORY: ::Apple is spending $30 billion in Broadcom chips deal::Stephen Nellis/Technology Correspondent::July 8, 2026"Apple and Broadcom on Wednesday announced a $30 billion deal that runs through 2031 for Broadcom to supply chips to Apple. Now, this isn't a completely new relationship between Apple, the maker of the iPhone and the iPad, and Broadcom, one of its longtime suppliers. In 2023, the two companies said that they had a multibillion, multiyear deal to supply chips from a factory in Fort Collins, Colorado to Apple. But what this is a major expansion of that partnership.
